definitions.cells: <direction>_<grade>: Telegram single-vacancy IT posts of the direction's roles (it: all IT) and of the grade (all: every post, a post without a grade included).
definitions.directions: directions.<year>.<direction>: posts of the direction's roles of all IT posts of the panel channels (IT posts in every year from the base year); directions.panel_channels: panel channels of all.
definitions.grades: grades.<year>.<grade>: posts of the grade of the IT posts that name a grade; grades.<year>.graded: IT posts that name a grade of all IT posts.
definitions.share: posts of the cell naming the skill (extracted skills) of the cell's posts; recent pools 2025-2026, a year by the week's Monday.
